page.description: The Administration site is the shared home base for day-to-day operations at Moonlight Resources. General Documents holds the paperwork that doesn't have a more specific home, Policies and Procedures is the source of truth for how things are done, and Templates gives you a starting point instead of formatting from scratch. If you're not sure where something belongs company-wide, it probably starts here.
